claims.text: Ghosn was arrested in Tokyo in November 2018; the SEC alleges he concealed more than $90 million in compensation from public disclosure
Nissan's board voted to remove Ghosn as Chairman and Representative Director on November 22, 2018
Hiroto Saikawa became Nissan's CEO after Ghosn's removal
Ghosn was released on bail on December 25, 2018 after over a month in detention
Ghosn fled Japan to Lebanon on December 29, 2019 while awaiting trial

outcome.summary: Ghosn was arrested in Tokyo in November 2018; the SEC alleges he concealed more than $90 million in compensation from public disclosure. Nissan's board removed him as Chairman. He was released on bail in December 2018 but fled Japan to Lebanon in December 2019 while awaiting trial. Nissan pursued civil claims against him for damages. The French prosecutor dropped its investigation in 2023.

title: Carlos Ghosn arrested and dismissed as Nissan Chairman
trigger: Carlos Ghosn was arrested in Japan on suspicion of financial misconduct; the SEC alleges he concealed more than $90 million in compensation from public disclosure over eight years, leading Nissan's board to dismiss him as Chairman and Representative Director.
